Component showcase

Every component,
one page.

Scroll through or press P to present. Each section shows one kit component with sample data and a one-line description of when to use it.

How to use this library
  1. BrowseScroll or press P to see each component working with real sample data.
  2. ChooseNote the exact name in its section label, such as chart — stat.
  3. UseChoose Change visual beside a section, or ask your agent to use that component by name.

06f · stack — diff

A fat handler, split

mode:'diff' — the same stack chrome, two panes. Move ribbons trace what relocated between files, a violet badge marks a rename, and success/error weight marks what was added or died.

07 · flow

Canary rollout progression

A release advances from candidate to full rollout through one explicit SLO gate. Branching systems belong in architecture diagrams; this rail is for an ordered journey.

08 · flow — timeline

Dates on a dedicated axis

Milestones stand on the track by date; quarter labels sit on the axis below and a dashed line marks today. For parallel workstreams, use the roadmap.

08b · roadmap

Parallel work, one horizon

Dated spans and milestones stay aligned across workstreams; dependencies and today get their own visual grammar.
